text: My take last night told the story. Tonight I let it breathe. The old man doesn't rush anything — four seasons, forestry, teaching, guitars in the winter. My first take was too eager to tell you who he is. Tonight he just is.
That's the seasoning. Not adding. Letting.
The pedal steel's going to carry the bridge this time. That's his guitar voice — the one he builds in the off-season.
